if not a.exists():
 with tarfile.open(a,"x:gz") as t:
  for f in files:
   assert f.is_file() and not f.is_symlink(); t.add(f,arcname=f.name,recursive=False)
b=a.read_bytes()
with tarfile.open(a,"r:gz") as t:
 members=t.getmembers(); assert len(members)==19
 for m in members:
  assert m.isfile() and pathlib.PurePosixPath(m.name).name==m.name
  assert t.extractfile(m).read()==(p/m.name).read_bytes()
print(json.dumps({"key":"caps-v5","records":str(p),"archive":str(a),"bytes":len(b),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),"members":19,"outcomes":outcomes,"units":units,"binary":binary,"base64":base64.b64encode(b).decode()}))
